claim: Correct Android libzim Zstd stream-memory accounting without reducing the nominal cache budget or changing archive decoding and authority contracts
status: Source fix and focused host regression exercised; Android release memory benefit not established

upstream.defect: ZSTD_INFO::state_size queried the null encoder when a decoder existed, and the null decoder otherwise. Pinned Zstd returns zero for these null size queries.
upstream.fix: Query ZSTD_sizeof_DStream for a decoder, otherwise ZSTD_sizeof_CStream for the encoder.
upstream.timing: Cluster construction decodes the offset table before cache insertion. Zstd initializes streaming buffers before producing that output, so corrected insertion accounting observes initialized decoder allocations.

integration.strictPatchAcceptance: Corrected patch successfully dry-ran and applied with --fuzz=0 to freshly extracted, checksum-verified pinned source after preceding required patches were applied to their respective components.
integration.previousApplicationFinding: The first SDK attempt rejected an insufficiently contextualized test-include hunk. The hunk was corrected, independently reviewed, and exercised on fresh source; the failed work tree was not reused.

hostRegression.configuration: Reader-only native core; Xapian disabled; header buffering disabled; only compression and decoderstreamreader targets built

before.failure: Encoder accounting returned 0 versus 5280 bytes; decoder accounting returned 0 versus 95984 bytes
Cluster insertion cost equaled the decoder-free baseline: 131160 versus 131160 bytes

cases.coverage: Insertion cost before any blob read, eviction of an unowned cached cluster, and continued access through a live owner after cache eviction

realArchiveHostProbe.scope: Read-only host Zstd 1.5.7 decoder allocations after each compressed cluster offset table was decoded; each decoder was freed before sampling the next cluster

boundaries: The nominal global cluster-cache budget remains 16777216 bytes. No cache-capacity reduction was made.
Accounting remains an estimate: offsets plus half the decoded extent and a stream-memory contribution clamped to the decoded extent. This correction is not a hard allocated- or resident-memory cap.
Cache costs are recorded at insertion; later decoder growth is not dynamically recosted. Existing single-oversized-entry retention behavior remains unchanged.
Host decoder allocation is not Android PSS. All-cluster probe values must not be summed and presented as simultaneously retained memory or savings.
A small real reading working set may remain below the corrected budget and cause no additional eviction or memory reduction.
No phone access or phone-memory claim is part of this evidence. Android SDK/release integration and physical memory acceptance remain separate checks.
